# v2.0.0 — documentation-author rename, suggest-first skills, verified downloads, real evals

## Breaking change

`doc-author` is renamed `documentation-author`, to match `documentation-review` and the full-word names of the other skills. Its behaviour is unchanged.

- Invoke it as `/documentation-author`, or `agent-skills:documentation-author` through the plugin.
- `make update` installs the new name and removes old `doc-author` copies that came from this repository. It keeps your own skill or a link with that name.
- `make status` lists any old copies that remain.

## Highlights since v1.1.2

- **Suggest before asking.** Every skill now reads the repository first and sends one batch of suggestions, each with its evidence, for you to accept or correct. `backstage-catalog-builder` ranks owner signals (descriptors, `CODEOWNERS`, catalog groups, maintainers) and flags placeholder owners such as `group:default/catalog-test`.
- **Verified downloads.** `make skill-llm-verify` checks SHA-256 digests for the pinned llama.cpp archives and a revision-pinned model. It no longer ignores `LLAMA_CPP_URL`, `LLAMA_BUILD`, or `LLM_MODEL_URL` when a cache exists. CI runs it on Linux x64 and arm64 and macOS arm64 and Intel.
- **Real evals.** `make skill-evals` grades every skill with any model command. The review skills use a real diff and real pages with planted defects and clean companions. Answer keys are never sent to the model. A run that matches no case, or gets a bad argument, now fails instead of reporting success.
- **Stricter report graders.** They read the severity and evidence columns, enforce risk order, and check that verdicts agree with findings.
- **Pinned CI inputs.** The Claude Code CLI used for manifest validation is pinned, and the local-model cache key follows the pins.
- **Repository checks.** Every commit and CI run now lints Markdown (markdownlint) and shell scripts (shellcheck), audits the workflows (zizmor), and scans for secrets (gitleaks; CI scans the full history). Every GitHub Action and pre-commit hook is pinned to a commit, and Dependabot proposes updates after a week's cooldown.
- **Versions and releases are checked.** A changed skill must raise its version and update the changelog, and releases are published from CI once a version passes.

## Eval results

Claude Opus 5.5, three runs per case with the skill and one without:

| Skill | With the skill | Without |
| --- | --- | --- |
| backstage-catalog-builder | 6/6 | 1/2 |
| documentation-author | 5/6 | 1/2 |
| documentation-review | 6/6 | 0/2 |
| peer-code-review | 5/6 | 0/2 |

The two failures: one rewrite left a `TODO` comment in the page, and one review raised duplicated retry logic only as a question.

## Correction to v1.1.2

The v1.1.2 notes reported 8/8 and 10/10 recall. Those fixtures showed only part of the change and included the answer key in the model's input, so the figures did not measure the skills. The results above replace them.
